name: Unnati Scheme
nodalDept: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Karnataka
briefDescription: The Unnati Scheme, an initiative by the Karnataka Department of Social Welfare, offers a comprehensive entrepreneurship platform for startups, supporting end-to-end requirements.
descriptionMd: The Unnati Scheme is a pioneering initiative from the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Karnataka. It aims to provide a comprehensive entrepreneurship platform specifically designed for startups. The program focuses on addressing the end-to-end requirements of startups, starting from the crucial stage of identifying innovations.
benefitsMd:
- Provides a comprehensive entrepreneurship platform
- Caters to end-to-end requirements of a startup
- Supports the identification of innovations
eligibilityMd:
- Open to startups seeking a comprehensive entrepreneurship platform in Karnataka.
- For individuals or groups involved in identifying innovations and developing new ventures.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
